records.source: I wonder how Penny is doing? Maybe I'll give her a call later today.
records.translation: Kumusta na kaya si Penny? Baka tawagan ko siya mamaya.

records.source: I was just daydreaming... do you think MARILDA is okay? I hope she finds some place where she truly belongs...
records.translation: Nangangarap lang ako nang gising... sa tingin mo ba ay maayos si MARILDA? Sana makahanap siya ng lugar na tunay na para sa kanya...

records.source: Hey! I had trouble sleeping last night so I fiddled around in my workshop for a bit. Here, I made this for you. [688 369 338 325 287]#$e#I hope you can find some use for it.
records.translation: Uy! Nahirapan akong matulog kagabi kaya may kinalikot ako sandali sa pagawaan ko. Heto, ginawa ko ito para sa iyo. [688 369 338 325 287]#$e#Sana ay mapakinabangan mo ito.

records.source: The only thing I dislike about rain is the fact that I can't do any stargazing!
records.translation: Ang tanging ayaw ko sa ulan ay hindi ako makapagmamasid sa mga bituin!

records.source: Do I hear a leak in the roof? I'll have to check it out. I know a thing or two about carpentry from watching my mother.
records.translation: May naririnig ba akong tagas sa bubong? Kailangan kong tingnan iyon. May kaunti akong alam sa pagkakarpintero mula sa pagmamasid kay Nanay.

records.source: Make sure you don't leave your tools out in the rain! You wouldn't want them to get all rusty.
records.translation: Tiyakin mong hindi maiiwan sa ulan ang mga kagamitan mo! Ayaw mong kalawangin ang mga iyon.

records.source: I'm not sure what this is, yet... but it's fun to turn the old wrench now and then.
records.translation: Hindi ko pa tiyak kung ano ito... pero masayang paikutin paminsan-minsan ang lumang liyabe.

records.source: Hi @. How was your day... soggy?#$e#This weather gives me gadget ideas... maybe if I funnel the rainwater it could power a mill?
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Kumusta ang araw mo... basang-basa?#$e#Nagbibigay sa akin ng mga ideya para sa mga aparato ang ganitong panahon... baka mapagana ng tubig-ulan ang isang Gilingan kung itutuon ko ang daloy nito?

records.source: Dad's been tracking the weather patterns for the last twenty years.#$e#It's a little too early to tell, but the results have revealed some abnormal trends.
records.translation: Dalawampung taon nang sinusubaybayan ni Papa ang mga padron ng panahon.#$e#Medyo maaga pa para makatiyak, pero may ilang di-pangkaraniwang kalakarang ipinakita ang mga resulta.

records.source: Can we have spaghetti in bed tonight?
records.translation: Puwede ba tayong kumain ng spaghetti sa kama ngayong gabi?

records.source: I made some dessert! Make sure to brush your teeth before bed, though. [232 234 223 220]$h
records.translation: Gumawa ako ng panghimagas! Pero tiyakin mong magsipilyo bago matulog. [232 234 223 220]$h

records.source: My day wasn't all that exciting... I stayed inside because of the weather.#$e#It was relaxing, though. I kicked back with the latest 'Schematics Weekly'.
records.translation: Hindi gaanong kapana-panabik ang araw ko... Nanatili ako sa loob dahil sa panahon.#$e#Pero nakapagpahinga naman ako. Nagrelaks ako habang binabasa ang pinakabagong “Lingguhang Guhit-Teknikal”.

records.source: Hmm? Sorry, sometimes I get so lost in thought that I don't even realize what I'm doing.
records.translation: Hmm? Pasensiya na, minsan ay nalulubog ako nang husto sa pag-iisip kaya hindi ko namamalayan ang ginagawa ko.

records.source: I found this in my scrap pile. Think you could find a use for it? [286 287 205 732]
records.translation: Nakita ko ito sa bunton ng mga piyesa ko. Sa tingin mo, mapakikinabangan mo ito? [286 287 205 732]

records.source: Finally, you're up! I was getting so hungry... *rumble*$h
records.translation: Sa wakas, gising ka na! Gutom na gutom na ako... *kumalam*$h

records.source: One of the best things about living on the farm is waking up to a chorus of songbirds.
records.translation: Isa sa pinakamagandang bagay sa pagtira sa bukid ang paggising sa koro ng mga ibong mang-aawit.

records.source: How do you keep your hands so soft with all that farm work?
records.translation: Paano mo napapanatiling napakalambot ang mga kamay mo sa dami ng trabaho mo sa bukid?

records.source: Did you see the moon tonight? It always looks spectacular on the horizon.
records.translation: Nakita mo ba ang buwan ngayong gabi? Lagi itong kahanga-hangang tingnan sa abot-tanaw.

records.source: I saw a shooting star earlier. I like to pretend it's MARILDA stopping by to check on us.$h
records.translation: May nakita akong bulalakaw kanina. Gusto kong magkunwaring si MARILDA iyon na dumaan upang kumustahin tayo.$h

records.source: I can't decide if I'm craving chocolate cake or ripe strawberries. Or maybe both...?#$e#Be honest... am I gaining weight?$s
records.translation: Hindi ako makapagpasiyang Keyk na Tsokolate o hinog na mga strawberry ang gusto kong kainin. O baka pareho...?#$e#Magtapat ka... tumataba ba ako?$s

records.source: You did good work today! You deserve to relax the rest of the evening.
records.translation: Mahusay ang ginawa mo ngayon! Karapat-dapat kang magpahinga sa natitirang bahagi ng gabi.

records.source: I'm really starting to love this old house. It's so cozy at night.#$e#Mom's done a great job improving the place.$h
records.translation: Nagsisimula na akong mahalin ang lumang bahay na ito. Napakaginhawa rito sa gabi.#$e#Napakahusay ng ginawa ni Nanay sa pagpapaganda ng lugar.$h

records.source: Ahh... the farm smells great, it reminds me of the mountains near my parent's house.
records.translation: Ahh... napakabango ng bukid, ipinaaalala nito sa akin ang kabundukang malapit sa bahay ng mga magulang ko.

records.source: With a little planning, we could automate most of the farm work and just relax!
records.translation: Sa kaunting pagpaplano, maaari nating gawing awtomatiko ang karamihan sa gawain sa bukid at magpahinga na lang!

records.source: It's going to be clear tonight... I wonder if the %noun constellation will be visible?
records.translation: Maaliwalas mamayang gabi... Iniisip ko kung makikita ang konstelasyong %noun?

records.source: Don't worry, I won't mind if you track mud into the house. It's fun to get a little dirty now and then.
records.translation: Huwag kang mag-alala, ayos lang sa akin kung makapagpasok ka ng putik sa bahay. Masayang marumihan nang kaunti paminsan-minsan.

records.source: I never realized the amount of care and planning necessary to run a farm! It's a lot like working in the laboratory.
records.translation: Hindi ko inakalang ganito karaming pag-aalaga at pagpaplano ang kailangan upang magpatakbo ng bukid! Katulad na katulad ito ng pagtatrabaho sa laboratoryo.

records.source: Have you spent any time with %kid1 today? Kids need playtime in order reach their full potential.
records.translation: Naglaan ka ba ng oras kay %kid1 ngayon? Kailangan ng mga bata ang oras sa paglalaro upang maabot ang buong kakayahan nila.

records.source: What do you think... will %kid1 grow up to be a farmer? Or an engineer?
records.translation: Ano sa tingin mo... magiging magsasaka ba si %kid1 paglaki? O inhinyero?

records.source: I have high hopes for our child. I've been reading all the scientific data on the best ways to raise children.
records.translation: Mataas ang mga inaasahan ko para sa anak natin. Binabasa ko ang lahat ng siyentipikong datos tungkol sa pinakamahuhusay na paraan ng pagpapalaki ng mga bata.

records.source: My own workshop, two wonderful kids, and a beautiful plot of land. Life is pretty good.
records.translation: Sarili kong pagawaan, dalawang kahanga-hangang anak, at magandang lupain. Maganda talaga ang buhay.

records.source: Now that we live together, it's hard to imagine being alone again.
records.translation: Ngayong magkasama na tayong nakatira, mahirap isiping mapag-isa ulit.

records.source: Taking a break? That's good!
records.translation: Nagpapahinga ka? Mabuti iyan!

records.source: There's a lot of strategy to planning and running a farm. It's more intellectually stimulating than I thought!
records.translation: Maraming estratehiya ang kailangan sa pagpaplano at pagpapatakbo ng bukid. Mas nakapagpapasigla pala ito sa isip kaysa sa inaakala ko!

records.source: For a while there I was considering building a robotic ${husband^wife}$. But you're a lot more fun!$h
records.translation: May panahong pinag-iisipan kong bumuo ng robot na ${asawa^asawa}$. Pero mas masaya kang kasama!$h

records.source: I was just admiring my wedding amulet... The shell is flawless. This is a very rare specimen!$l
records.translation: Hinahangaan ko lang ang palawit ko sa kasal... Walang bahid ang kabibe. Napakadalang ng espesimeng ito!$l

records.source: Last night, I had a dream that I was looking through a gigantic telescope. I saw something moving in the %noun nebula. Kind of spooky.
records.translation: Nanaginip ako kagabi na tumitingin ako sa isang dambuhalang teleskopyo. May nakita akong gumagalaw sa nebulang %noun. Medyo nakatatakot.

records.source: I hope you'd still like me even if I gained weight.
records.translation: Sana ay gusto mo pa rin ako kahit tumaba ako.

records.source: I feel uninspired today.$s
records.translation: Wala akong inspirasyon ngayon.$s

records.source: I think I'll visit my parents today. I haven't seen them in a while.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko ay dadalawin ko ang mga magulang ko ngayon. Matagal ko na silang hindi nakikita.

records.source: Mom and Dad are doing just fine. Their routine is still the same, even with me gone. How was your day?
records.translation: Maayos na maayos sina Nanay at Papa. Pareho pa rin ang rutina nila kahit wala na ako. Kumusta ang araw mo?

records.source: So, what's your strategy for optimizing the farm this year?
records.translation: Aba, ano ang estratehiya mo upang mapahusay ang bukid ngayong taon?

records.source: It's wonderful to see all the plants and animals come back to life during the spring.
records.translation: Kahanga-hangang makitang muling nabubuhay ang lahat ng halaman at hayop tuwing tagsibol.

records.source: If my brother wasn't such a hermit I'd invite him over for dinner sometime.
records.translation: Kung hindi ganoon kamapag-isa ang kapatid ko, aanyayahan ko sana siya minsan para sa hapunan.

records.source: I wonder if my brother will ever have the courage to ask Abigail out?
records.translation: Iniisip ko kung magkakaroon kaya ng lakas ng loob ang kapatid ko na anyayahan si Abigail na makipagtipan?

records.source: I like to catalogue the different insects I see in summer.
records.translation: Gusto kong itala ang iba’t ibang insektong nakikita ko sa tag-init.

records.source: With every season, a new section of the night sky becomes prominent. It's fascinating to witness.
records.translation: Sa bawat panahon, nagiging litaw ang isang bagong bahagi ng kalangitan sa gabi. Kahanga-hanga itong masaksihan.

records.source: Winter's just around the corner. We need to double check the heating system, turn off the valves, and check all the insulation in the house.#$e#Don't worry, dear. I'll take care of it all.
records.translation: Malapit na ang taglamig. Kailangan nating suriing muli ang sistema ng pagpainit, isara ang mga balbula, at tingnan ang lahat ng insulasyon sa bahay.#$e#Huwag kang mag-alala, mahal. Ako na ang bahala sa lahat.

records.source: Fall always reminds me of going out woodcutting with my mom... it might be that smell of freshly cut wood and sap.
records.translation: Laging ipinaaalala sa akin ng taglagas ang pagputol namin ni Nanay ng kahoy... baka dahil sa amoy ng bagong putol na kahoy at dagta.

records.source: The winters have been disturbingly mild lately.
records.translation: Nakababahalang masyadong banayad ang mga taglamig nitong huli.

records.source: I hope Dad's doing okay... he can get depressed in winter, when there's less opportunity for field research.
records.translation: Sana ay maayos si Papa... nalulungkot siya kapag taglamig dahil mas kaunti ang pagkakataon para sa pananaliksik sa labas.

records.source: So, what are your plans for maintaining our income this winter?#$e#You could do some fishing or foraging...#$e#If you do any mining, promise me you'll be careful.
records.translation: Aba, ano ang mga plano mo upang mapanatili ang kita natin ngayong taglamig?#$e#Maaari kang mangisda o mangalap...#$e#Kung magmimina ka, ipangako mong mag-iingat ka.

records.source: I'm feeling excited for a new year of farming, @!$h
records.translation: Nasasabik ako sa bagong taon ng pagsasaka, @!$h

records.source: The evenings are so warm, it's really the best time of year for stargazing. Who knows what might up there?
records.translation: Napakainit ng mga gabi, kaya ito talaga ang pinakamagandang panahon ng taon para magmasid sa mga bituin. Sino ang nakaaalam kung ano ang maaaring naroon sa itaas?

records.source: The farm life is great, but I'm glad I still work at the clinic... It's an important service for the community.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng buhay sa bukid, pero natutuwa akong nagtatrabaho pa rin ako sa klinika... Mahalagang serbisyo iyon para sa komunidad.

records.source: I'm really looking forward to having rhubarb pie in the spring. Oh... that tang, that zest!
records.translation: Talagang inaasam ko ang Pai ng Rubarbo sa tagsibol. Ah... ang asim, ang sigla ng lasa!

records.source: #$c .5#I got up early to do a little stargazing.#$e#I hope you don't mind if I spend some time on my projects today, honey.
records.translation: #$c .5#Maaga akong bumangon upang magmasid nang kaunti sa mga bituin.#$e#Sana ay ayos lang sa iyo kung maglaan ako ng oras sa mga proyekto ko ngayon, mahal.
